title: 第一卷 南域篇 第23章 饮酒杀一人第一卷 南域篇 第24章 御剑行九天
slug: 剑问九州第1286章星域虫潮
content_zh:
山鬼脸色变了，阴沉得诡异。
她忽然站了起来，凑到白泽眼前。
饮酒之后，山鬼脸颊有淡淡的红晕，那双淡绿色的眼眸好像盛了一汪春湖，诱人至极。
“喝了我的酒，就要帮我杀一人。”山鬼神色诡异，吐气如兰，却在这句话一出时，就让白泽惊得一身冷汗，酒全醒了。
“杀谁？”白泽发觉浑身无法动弹，只愣愣地盯着山鬼的眼睛，问。
“李牧之。”山鬼一字一顿，将那个名字念了出来。
白泽只觉得灵魂深处响起一声炸雷，骨头都酥了，“当今九州剑仙，道门已经成为传说的老神仙，李牧之？”
“没错。”山鬼透亮的眼眸一瞬间充满恨意，“我要你帮我杀了他。”
“我一个苦海四重天，如何杀得了那等人物？”白泽只觉得不切实际，他已经是九州传说，连谢玄见了都要绕道走的老神仙，他一个苦海，恐怕对方一个眼神他就魂飞魄散，死无葬身之地了！
“如何不能？”山鬼说，“超凡四境，至尊，贤者，圣人，传说。李牧之踏入天道，已经摸到了四境顶峰。百年内他都无法再进一步，可你不同。”
白泽一身冷汗。
“你先天道胎，百年登临圣人九重巅峰，再入传说，未必不可能。”山鬼定定地看着他，“我不会白让你去杀他，我会把我的所有，全部给你。”
白泽张张嘴，却一句话说不出来。
他觉得应该是酒劲又上头了，双眼昏沉，视觉重影。
山鬼又在唱歌，歌声空灵，却充满忧伤。
“雷填填兮雨冥冥，
猿啾啾兮狖夜鸣。
风飒飒兮木萧萧，
思公子兮徒离忧。”
白泽精神恍惚，那歌声是《山鬼谣》的下半曲，雷雨冥冥，猿声哀愁。深夜时分，木叶随风飘零，伊人独立山海，思念公子，却徒得忧伤。

那歌声中有酒，酒杯中有故事。
月光如雾，缥缈如烟。荷塘深处，山鬼轻歌，满池的荷花翩翩起舞，灯笼草的光晕，将这里点亮，仿佛女神的珍珠。
纹狸慵懒地打着哈欠，草屋那边，赤豹听见歌声，抬头往山鬼所在的荷塘看了一眼，又低下头去，闭目凝神。
“喝了我的酒，就要帮我杀一人。”
“杀谁？”
“李牧之。”
……
白泽天旋地转，醉的厉害，昏昏睡去。
山鬼听见耳边平稳的呼吸声，歌声渐止。她素手一招，将无锋剑拔了出来，握在手中，一步踏出，人已在荷塘之中。
夜风沉醉，山鬼脚踏芙蓉，身轻如燕，仿佛没有重量。
“无量一剑。”她轻轻说，一剑挥出。
半面荷塘枝残叶落，花瓣破碎飞天。
content_en:
The mountain ghost's expression changed, becoming strangely gloomy.
She suddenly stood up and approached Bai Ze.
After drinking, there was a faint blush on Shangui's cheeks, and his light green eyes seemed to be filled with a spring lake, extremely alluring.
"If you drink my wine, you will kill someone for me." The mountain ghost looked strange and exhaled like blue. But as soon as he said these words, Bai Ze was so shocked that he broke into a cold sweat and woke up from the wine.
"Who to kill?" Bai Ze found that he couldn't move and could only stare blankly into the mountain ghost's eyes and asked.
"Li Muzhi." Shangui read out the name word by word.
Bai Ze only felt a thunder sound in the depths of his soul, and his bones went numb, "The current Jiuzhou Sword Immortal, the Taoist sect has become a legendary old immortal, Li Muzhi?"
"That's right." Mountain Ghost's bright eyes were filled with hatred for a moment, "I want you to help me kill him."
"How can I, a person from the fourth level of the sea of suffering, kill such a person?" Bai Ze felt it was unrealistic. He was already a legend in Kyushu, an old god who even Xie Xuan would avoid when he saw him. He was like a sea of suffering, and I'm afraid that with just one look from the other person, he would lose his soul and die without a place to bury him!
"Why not?" Shangui said, "The four realms of transcendence are the supreme, the sage, the saint, and the legend. Li Muzhi stepped into the way of heaven and has reached the top of the four realms. He will not be able to go any further within a hundred years, but you are different."
Bai Ze was covered in cold sweat.
"It may not be impossible for you to be born with Taoism, reach the peak of the ninth level of saints in a hundred years, and then enter the legend again." Shangui looked at him steadily, "I will not let you kill him in vain, I will give you everything I have."
Bai Ze opened his mouth, but no words came out.
He thought he must have gotten drunk again, his eyes were dizzy and his vision was double.
The mountain ghost is singing again, the song is ethereal but full of sadness.
"The thunder fills the rain,
Apes chirp and bark at night.
The wind rustles and the trees rustle,
I miss you, but I am worried about you. "
Bai Ze was in a trance, and the song was the second half of "Mountain Ghost Ballad". There was a thunderstorm and the sound of apes was sad. Late at night, the wooden leaves are drifting in the wind, and the beautiful woman is independent of the mountains and seas. She misses the young master, but in vain.
There is wine in the singing, and stories in the wine glass.
The moonlight is like fog, misty like smoke. Deep in the lotus pond, mountain ghosts sang softly, and the lotus flowers dancing in the pond were dancing. The halo of lantern grass lit up the place, like the pearl of a goddess.
Wenli yawned lazily. Over there in the thatched cottage, Chibao heard the singing, raised his head and glanced at the lotus pond where the mountain ghost was, then lowered his head and closed his eyes to concentrate.
"If you drink my wine, you will kill someone for me."
"Kill who?"
"Li Muzhi."
…
Bai Ze was spinning. He was so drunk that he fell asleep.
The mountain ghost heard the steady breathing in his ears, and the singing gradually stopped. With one move of her bare hands, she pulled out the edgeless sword, held it in her hand, stepped out, and found herself in the lotus pond.
The night wind is intoxicating, and the mountain ghost steps on the hibiscus. His body is as light as a swallow, as if he has no weight.
"Immortal sword." She said softly and swung the sword.
On half of the lotus pond, the branches and leaves have fallen, and the petals are broken and flying into the sky.
